topic.title: 🏅 WEAR Challenge 2025 – Now with Cash Prizes up to €300!

messages.content:
Dear challenge participants!

The WEAR Challenge 2025 is in full swing, and the leaderboard is incredibly tight! To raise the stakes and reward the best solutions, we’re excited to announce cash prizes for the top 3 teams:

🥇 1st place: €300
🥈 2nd place: €150
🥉 3rd place: €75

Important: To be eligible for the cash prizes, winners must submit a technical report to HASCA 2025 and present their solution at the conference. This is a great opportunity to showcase your work to the research community and get valuable feedback!

If you’ve been following along or haven’t jumped in yet, now is the perfect time to join! There’s about one month left to build, train, and fine-tune your models to claim a spot on the podium.

How to get started:

  • Register for the challenge here on Kaggle.
  • Download the data and start training your models
  • Submit your predictions on Kaggle and technical report on PCS before the deadline (July 4th, AoE). More details on this will follow in a separate post.
  • Join us at HASCA 2025 to celebrate the winners!

If you have any questions or want to share your progress, feel free to post them here or reach out via e-mail (marius.bock@uni-siegen.de).

Good luck everyone! 🚀

Marius
